ns2:course.label: Choral Conducting Project
ns2:course.description: Participation in a graduate choral conducting laboratory and preparation of a choral ensemble for public performance. Required during the final term in residence for candidates in the Master of Music in choral music curriculum. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Music Education or Music or Musicology major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: One additional hour to be arranged.
